T008 Reviewer PHASE2 SUPPLEMENTAL source-first expectation (actor urn:a-c:T008:claude-reviewer:001; activation urn:a-c:T008:review-assessment-activation:001). This is SEPARATE from the original phase1 expectation sha256:4387cefa103592b5a76c96d288da403f9211bc3107843bc8dbfa63c501653f61; it neither rewrites nor raises the original source-derived-expectations judgment (indeterminate/performed_partial). Derived only from phase2 governing acquisitions made before any candidate/HOW/code/helper/test/fixture/proof/guide bytes: DESIGN_MODULE 442-500, 572-616, 996-1052, 1101-1153, 1312-1354, 1479-1547; fd-support-tools 1-237 (FD013 remainder 231-237 now read; file ends at 237); PRODUCT 1-140; INTENT; REFERENCE_FRAME_BASIS; stdo_a_c.json; fd-source-owner-map 1-150; FOUNDATIONS 790-850 and 1008-1060; EVALUATION 178-309; REFERENCE_FRAME 281-440; FDV 1-84; ASSURANCE 680-756; TASK; T-008 785-860; review-claim.json content not read.

S1 design-conservation (refines E1): the FD-support HOW introduces public operations, effects and authority, so it is a material semantic boundary under DESIGN_MODULE s5/s7. Expect: one cited Ontology = entities + identities + relationships + invariants + lifecycle + authority + atomic functions + higher-order composition + effects + projections (an operation/schema/command inventory alone is not an Ontology); whole-family Prime contraction where every candidate atom kind enters one contraction, each accepted atom declares an admitted domain, and every realisation unit maps explicitly to atoms (e.g. whether separately named operations contract to parameterised atoms); three distinct views (Mermaid classDiagram, sequenceDiagram, stateDiagram-v2) derived from the Ontology, not one flowchart; a cross-view axiom table with pass/fail/not_applicable mapped to core values and gap owners; decision-completeness of M(B) incl. failure/refusal routes, effect/closure laws, public contracts and module mappings. Implementation-introduced material semantic decisions or contradictory projections mean underconstrained. Also: F_D[v] judgments distinct from named acquisition/context/dispatch/write operations; builder STDO 2.5.1-rc.2, consumer RC9 profile and represented subject bases distinct with no label/co-location join; no second lifecycle/ledger/frame or next-action selection; method meaning by reference to owner clauses. Falsified by a named element violating these; indeterminate where cited evidence cannot decide. Design acceptance is not Reviewer authority.

S2 implementation-conservation (adds to E2): FD013 complete: attempt/cost records with units, measured scope, elapsed vs summed actor intervals, usage/cache counters, partial/failed calls, unknown counters and limit-check result; reproducible aggregation without double counting; anticipated separate from observed; unavailable backend usage stays unknown; no benefit inference. Joins follow FOUNDATIONS Conjunction: returned, planned-without-closed-result and uncovered inputs kept apart; any gap never satisfied; stale results are planned-without-result, not relabelled; not-performed carries no core value (EVALUATION s4). ASSURANCE s11: proof must acquire owner-issued subject via runnable surface.

S3 guide-task-criteria: TASK 1-6 as E3; additionally the guide must not present tool output as a semantic verdict/disposition, or a fresh context as independence (EVALUATION s3/s4).

S4 public-use-qualification: FDV001 needs one real bounded task with ordinary Executive/Worker/Reviewer use; FDV002 needs positive and negative controls per SC-002..014; harness-reconstructed state is not qualification; this review is one Reviewer actual-use datum, not qualification closure; historical Worker non-consumable return stays visible.

Limits: ACTIVATION, SPEC_METHOD, PRODUCT_DEFINITION, TICKETS, EXECUTIVE_BASELINE, AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS and method README unread in phase2; other DESIGN_MODULE sections unread; unknown prior/external/host/managed/memory exposure and mental continuity; same family and new process certify no independence.

scope: Full typed request/result pair and protected completed operation match; absent/preview responses remain unknown. No assistant narrative extracted.
